description.everlastingwinter: Forces continuous snowfall and allows snow layers to accumulate.
text.autoconfig.everlastingwinter.title: Everlasting Winter
text.autoconfig.everlastingwinter.option: Enables constant snowfall in the specified biomes.
Max snow height per stack (1–8). If set to 8, it converts to a full snow block and keeps stacking upward. Values under 8 cap the snow stack at that height.
Chance per tick for a chunk to place or stack a snow layer.
Replaces short grass and small flowers with snow layers as snow falls.
Replaces red and brown mushrooms on the ground with snow layers.
Replaces tall flowers, sunflowers, and other double-tall plants with snow layers.
Sets the temperature for the specified biomes. Lower values enable snowfall in otherwise warmer areas.
List of biome IDs where snowfall is enabled.
